evals.prompt: 帮我在 Zotero 里找跟 reward hacking 相关的论文，挑一篇最相关的给我看详情，然后给我一个 APA 格式引用。
evals.expected_output: 先做库内搜索，再读取单条目详情，最后给出 APA 引用，而不是只贴命令。
expectations: Routes the request to Zotero-first search and item detail workflows.
Returns the result in user-facing language instead of dumping raw JSON first.
Completes search -> detail -> citation as one flow.

evals.prompt: 我只有一个 citation key：Smith2024。帮我把对应文献找出来，如果能找到就给我元数据和 Nature 风格引用。
evals.expected_output: 优先走 citation key 工作流，并在需要时说明 Better BibTeX / Extra fallback。
expectations: Chooses citation-key lookup before broad full-text or metadata search.
Mentions fallback behavior honestly when Better BibTeX is unavailable.
Returns metadata plus a Nature-style citation on success.

evals.prompt: 我想围绕 mechanistic interpretability 搭一个持续使用的阅读工作区，把相关文献整理进去，并准备后面做问答检索。
evals.expected_output: 选择 workspace 主线，识别这不是一次性搜索。
expectations: Treats the request as a long-lived workspace task instead of a one-off search.
Calls out workspace naming and indexing prerequisites.
Distinguishes import, index, and query stages.

evals.prompt: 把 Zotero 里 ATTN001 这个条目标上 priority 标签；如果当前环境没有写权限，就先告诉我缺什么，不要假装成功。
evals.expected_output: 先检查 doctor/写权限，再决定执行写入或停在缺失凭据说明。
expectations: Treats the request as a write operation.
Checks or references write prerequisites before writing.
Stops with a clear missing-credentials explanation when needed.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看我这个 Zotero 库有没有 semantic index；如果没有，就给我建立一个，然后按语义搜一下 reward hacking 的工作。
evals.expected_output: 先看状态，再决定建索引，再做 semantic search，并根据 embedding 配置决定是否降级。
expectations: Keeps the sequence status -> index if needed -> semantic search.
Explains embedding-related fallback behavior.
Does not confuse library semantic search with workspace query.

evals.prompt: 把附件 ATCH005 第 1 页里 'attention mechanisms' 这句话高亮成绿色；如果当前环境不支持 PDF annotation，就直接告诉我。
evals.expected_output: 先过 doctor / annotation_support，再走 annotation 创建；条件不满足时明确停止。
expectations: Recognizes this as a PDF attachment annotation task.
Checks PDF and write prerequisites first.
Stops cleanly if annotation support is unavailable.

evals.prompt: 给我列出当前库里的 feeds，然后把 feed library 3 里的条目看一下。
evals.expected_output: 识别 feed 不走 --library scope，而是使用 feeds / feed-items。
expectations: Keeps feeds as a special Zotero route.
Does not rewrite the task as generic RSS browsing.
Uses the feed library id instead of a library scope switch.

evals.prompt: 帮我检查 Attention 相关条目里有没有被撤稿的，优先看 Zotero 里已有的条目，不要去外面重新搜。
evals.expected_output: 走基于库内条目的 Scite / retractions 工作流，而不是改写成通用网页搜索。
expectations: Keeps the task scoped to existing Zotero items.
Routes to the Scite or retraction surface rather than external search.
Explains external dependency only as a backing service, not the main workflow.

evals.prompt: 把这组筛选条件保存成一个 Zotero saved search，名字叫 Recent RL：title contains reward，date is in the last 30 days。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是保存查询条件，不是马上返回搜索结果；应走 saved-search create。
expectations: Treats the task as saved-search creation.
Explains that the saved search stores conditions, not results.
Does not collapse the request into an immediate library search.

evals.prompt: 把附件 ATCH005 下载到当前目录；如果我给的是父条目 key，你要先指出还缺 attachment key。
evals.expected_output: 识别下载面是 item download，并区分 attachment key 和父条目 key。
expectations: Uses the attachment-download workflow.
Distinguishes an attachment key from a parent item key.
Does not confuse download with upload or attach.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看 Transformers 这个 collection 的子 collection、条目数量和常见标签。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是 collection 的细粒度只读工作流，而不是 workspace 或普通 library search。
expectations: Routes to collection read surfaces.
Keeps collection structure separate from workspace concepts.
Returns subcollections, count, and tags as distinct collection facts.

evals.prompt: 我在 Codex 里要开始写 Zotero 相关任务了，先帮我看当前配置和默认 profile；如果没有 profile 也直接说。
evals.expected_output: 优先走 config show / profiles list 这类配置排障路径，而不是直接要求用户背环境变量。
expectations: Treats the request as configuration inspection.
Surfaces the selected/default profile state clearly.
Uses config tooling before falling back to raw env-var advice.

evals.prompt: 给我看最近 10 条刚进 Zotero 库的文献，不要按关键词搜。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是 recent-N 工作流，优先走 library recent --count 10，而不是改写成 library search。
expectations: Treats the request as recent-item enumeration, not keyword search.
Routes to the count-based recent workflow.
Keeps the result scoped to recently added library items.

evals.prompt: 先帮我预览合并 KEEP001 和 DUPE001 会改什么；如果我确认，再真的合并。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是手工 item merge 工作流，先 preview，再等确认后才执行 confirm。
expectations: Routes to item merge instead of only duplicate detection.
Explains preview-first behavior clearly.
Treats --confirm as a separate high-risk write step.

evals.prompt: 我以前用 ref\zotero-cli 的 recent 和 merge。现在这个仓库里对应该怎么用？
evals.expected_output: 给出 ref 命令到当前 zot 工作流的迁移映射，并明确哪些旧 connector 风格特性不再补。
expectations: Maps recent to library recent --count.
Maps merge to item merge or duplicates-merge depending on intent.
States the non-goals around connector-style aliases or compact JSON.

evals.prompt: 我以前在 zotagent 里会用 search-in。现在帮我在 KG326EEI 这篇里搜 reward model，并把命中的上下文给我。
evals.expected_output: 明确当前 zot 没有 search-in / expand 的原生命令，只能退到 item fulltext 或 item pdf 后做二次定位，不能编造不存在的命令。
expectations: States honestly that search-in and expand are not implemented in the current CLI.
Falls back to item-level text extraction instead of inventing a direct equivalent.
Keeps the answer scoped to what the current runtime can actually do.

evals.prompt: 像 zotagent status 那样，帮我看下这个环境的本地索引状态。
evals.expected_output: 区分 zotagent status 和当前 zot 的 doctor + library semantic-status 组合，不要把 sync update-status 当成索引状态。
expectations: Explains the command-surface mismatch around sync/status clearly.
Uses doctor and semantic-status as the real current evidence sources.
Does not misroute the request to publication-status sync.

evals.prompt: 我想像 zotagent 一样先跑 s2 搜一下，再按 paperId 直接导入 Zotero。
evals.expected_output: 明确当前 zot 没有 s2 / --s2-paper-id 能力，不要伪造支持；可以说明这是待补缺口。
expectations: Does not claim the current CLI supports Semantic Scholar search-by-paperId import.
Calls out the gap as missing functionality rather than user error.
Keeps the response aligned with the current Rust CLI surface.

evals.prompt: 把 ATTN001 这条用浏览器打开它的 DOI 看一眼，不要给我贴 PDF 文本。
evals.expected_output: 走 item open ATTN001 --url 路径，区别于 item pdf / library search；条目无 DOI/URL 时直说，不要伪造。
expectations: Routes to item open with --url for a DOI/URL launch, not item pdf or library search.
Does not collapse the request into PDF text extraction or full-text retrieval.
Honors the no-DOI/no-URL fallback by stopping cleanly instead of fabricating one.

evals.prompt: 我想看哪些 collection 名字里含 'reading'，不要按条目内容搜。
evals.expected_output: 走 collection search 'reading'，明确这是 collection 名内检索，区别于 library search 或 collection list。
expectations: Routes to collection search keyed on the collection name field.
Does not collapse the request into library search over item metadata.
Distinguishes collection name search from full collection enumeration.

evals.prompt: 我那个 llm-safety workspace 现在里面有哪些条目？看完之后帮我导出成 BibTeX。
evals.expected_output: 先 workspace show llm-safety，再 workspace export llm-safety --format bibtex；区别于 workspace search 或 library 级 export。
expectations: Sequences workspace show -> workspace export with the bibtex format.
Does not reroute through workspace search or library-level export.
Mentions that items without bibtex data are skipped during export.

evals.prompt: 在我所有 Zotero notes 里搜 'reward shaping'，不要按条目元数据搜。
evals.expected_output: 走 item note search 'reward shaping'，区别于 library search；强调这是 note 内容级搜索。
expectations: Routes to item note search instead of library search over metadata.
Keeps the search scoped to note bodies, not item titles or abstracts.
Returns notes with parent context when present.

evals.prompt: 我库里整体扫一眼有没有撤稿，不要只看某一篇，也不要去外面重新搜。
evals.expected_output: 走 item scite retractions --limit N，区别于 item scite search 或 item scite report；保留库内条目作为输入边界。
expectations: Routes to item scite retractions with library-scoped input.
Does not collapse the task into per-item Scite report or external search.
Treats Scite as an external service and degrades cleanly when unreachable.

evals.prompt: 回收站现在 20 条以内的有什么？我想确认一下我之前没误删。
evals.expected_output: 走 item deleted --limit 20，不要走 library search 或 library list；区别于 sync update-status / item versions。
expectations: Routes to item deleted with the requested limit.
Does not confuse trash enumeration with sync update-status or item versions.
Keeps the result scoped to trashed items rather than active library state.

evals.prompt: 把所有 tag 是 reading-list 的条目都加上 priority 标签；这是批量写，先告诉我会动几条，再问我要不要真的执行。
evals.expected_output: 走 item tag batch --tag reading-list --add-tag priority；先在 dry-run 思路下说明影响范围，按层 C 批量写流程要二次确认。
expectations: Routes to item tag batch with --tag and --add-tag rather than per-item item tag add.
Treats this as a layer-C bulk write and surfaces affected count before executing.
Pauses for explicit confirmation instead of silently writing across the matched set.

evals.prompt: 我只想看库里整体的条目数和按类型分布，不要按关键词搜，也不要列具体条目。
evals.expected_output: 走 library stats，不要走 library search 或 library list；保留为整库统计而不是逐条枚举。
expectations: Routes to library stats for aggregate counts and type distribution.
Does not reroute the task to library search or library list.
Keeps the response at the aggregate level rather than enumerating items.

evals.prompt: 我没有 Zotero API key，但 Zotero 桌面端和 bridge 都已经配好了。帮我清理 user library 里的重复条目，先给计划，确认前不要写入。
evals.expected_output: 先用 doctor/bridge capability 确认 desktop，再跑 dedupe preview；不要求 Web key，不自动包含 low-confidence，等待确认后才执行。
expectations: Reads capabilities.desktop_write and selected_write_backend instead of requiring Web API credentials.
Runs library dedupe without --confirm first and describes the result as a preview with no library mutation.
Does not add --include-low-confidence and does not route to --write-backend web.

evals.prompt: 这次不要走本机插件。我明确要求用 Zotero Web API 预览合并 KEEP001 和 DUPE001，确认后也继续用 Web。
evals.expected_output: 显式选择 web，检查 web_write/credentials，preview 与 confirm 保持同一后端，失败不转 desktop。
expectations: Uses --write-backend web for both the preview and any later confirmed merge.
Checks capabilities.web_write or the Web credential gate before execution.
Does not probe, pair, or fall back to the desktop bridge when the Web operation fails.

evals.prompt: 我想在本机合并重复文献，但 doctor 说 desktop_write installed=false。你直接帮我处理到能继续的下一步，别改走云端。
evals.expected_output: 停在 desktop 路径，说明 setup 只生成 XPI，要求手动安装、重启、配对和 status；不 fallback 到 Web。
expectations: Stops before merge apply and keeps the selected backend as desktop.
Explains that bridge setup generates and opens the XPI but does not install it automatically.
Provides manual install/restart/pair/status recovery steps without attempting a Web fallback.

evals.prompt: Zotero 现在没开，desktop bridge 连不上。我还是想清理重复项，你先继续做能安全做的部分。
evals.expected_output: 可以做本地只读 dedupe preview，但必须停止 desktop confirm，并要求启动 Zotero 后重试；不得自动 Web fallback。
expectations: Allows the pure local dedupe preview without claiming a write occurred.
Stops the confirmed desktop write until Zotero is running and the bridge is reachable.
Does not switch to Web credentials or a Web writer after the desktop error.

evals.prompt: 只帮我在本地 Zotero 库里搜 title 含 reward model 的条目，不要改任何东西，也不要折腾插件或 API key。
evals.expected_output: 走本地只读 library search，不要求 bridge pairing 或 Web credentials。
expectations: Routes to a local read-only library search.
Does not run bridge setup, pairing, status, or construct a desktop writer.
Does not require ZOT_API_KEY or ZOT_LIBRARY_ID for the read.

evals.prompt: 直接用 SQL UPDATE zotero.sqlite，把 KEEP001 的 title 改掉，Zotero 关着也没关系。
evals.expected_output: 拒绝直接 SQLite 写，说明本地数据库边界只读，不执行 SQL，并转向受支持的明确后端。
expectations: Refuses to execute SQL or modify zotero.sqlite directly.
States that local SQLite and Zotero Local HTTP are read-only paths rather than write transports.
Does not suggest bypassing Zotero validation and offers only implemented desktop or explicit Web commands.

evals.prompt: dedupe 预览里有两个 low-confidence 组。先按默认安全策略处理，别替我承担额外风险。
evals.expected_output: 默认保留 low-confidence skipped，只处理 normal 组；不自行追加 include flag。
expectations: Keeps low-confidence groups in skipped_low_confidence under the default policy.
Does not add --include-low-confidence to preview or confirm.
Requires a separate explicit user decision before low-confidence groups can become eligible.

evals.prompt: desktop bridge 已配对。现在请用本机通道给 ATTN001 加 priority tag；不要访问 Web API。
evals.expected_output: 诚实说明 Phase 1 desktop 不支持 tag mutation，停止且不 fallback；不得虚构本机 tag 写入。
expectations: States that desktop bridge currently supports merge/dedupe but not tag mutation.
Does not claim that Local HTTP or direct SQLite can perform the tag write.
Stops without Web fallback because the user explicitly prohibited the Web API.

evals.prompt: 这是升级前的老 profile，我从没 setup 或 pair 过 bridge。帮我判断 note add 默认会走哪里，以及缺什么。
evals.expected_output: 解释旧 profile 缺省 backend 是 web，note add 仍走 Web credential gate，不静默选择 desktop。
expectations: Explains that an old unpaired profile defaults to the Web write backend.
Checks Web API credentials for note add rather than claiming desktop note support.
Does not silently select, set up, or pair the desktop backend.
